description: The DECOMPOSED spelling of the same name — 'cafe', U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT, '.json' — kept in its own fixture because a normalization-insensitive filesystem would collide the two spellings inside one directory. Authoring note: verify the rawFiles key is 10 code points long and ends 'e', U+0301, '.json'. MEASURED on the oracle's host (APFS): the two spellings round-trip distinctly and the warning quotes each verbatim. Informational, because that is a filesystem property rather than a library one; where a platform normalizes, the two fixtures simply emit identical observations and nothing breaks.
